guidelines.photoQualityBody: Use a well-lit, in-focus photo. Natural daylight works best — avoid heavy shadows, blur, or filters that change the true color of the design.
guidelines.whatToIncludeBody: Show the full design clearly, with the hand, foot, or area fully visible in frame. A close-up detail shot is welcome as a separate submission.

support.title: Support
support.introBody: We're here for anything that isn't working the way you expect — designs that won't load or download, saved designs going missing, or feedback on the app.
support.introTip1: Pull down to refresh the screen — most loading issues clear on a retry.
support.introTip2: Check your internet connection; designs are loaded online.
support.introTip3: If a problem persists, tell us your device model and what you tapped just before it happened.
support.responseNote: We read every message and usually reply within 2–3 working days.

legal.aboutUsText:
Welcome to Mehandi App - your gallery of henna (mehandi) design inspiration, celebrating the art, culture, and tradition of mehandi from around the world!

Our Journey:
Mehandi App was born from a passion for the intricate beauty and cultural significance of mehandi designs. We set out to build a place where that beauty is easy to browse, save, and carry with you whenever you need inspiration.

Our Purpose:
At Mehandi App, our mission is simple: help you find the perfect mehandi design for any occasion, quickly and beautifully. We aim to make discovering and revisiting your favorite designs effortless, wherever you are.

Our Commitment:
We're committed to providing a well-organized, high-quality library of mehandi designs, thoughtfully categorized so you can find exactly what you're looking for - from everyday styles to bridal collections.

Features and Offerings:
- Browse an extensive gallery of mehandi designs, categorized by occasion, style, and regional tradition.
- Save your favorite designs to revisit anytime.
- Download designs to your device for offline reference.
- Share designs you love directly from the app.
- Keep your own reference photos privately in My Designs, saved only on your device.

Our Vision:
Our vision is to be your go-to source for mehandi inspiration - whether you're a bride planning your big day, an artist looking for references, or simply someone who loves the art of henna.

Contact Us:
Have questions, suggestions, or feedback in mind? Feel free to reach out to us at {{email}}. Your input is invaluable in shaping the Mehandi App experience.

Thank you for using Mehandi App, where art, culture, and creativity come together!
